mapper.sql: CONTRACTID, CONTRACTNO, CONTRACTNAME, CONTRACTTYPE, UNDERLYINGASSET, UNDERLYINGTYPE, COUNTERPARTY, COUNTERPARTYTYPE, NOTIONALAMOUNT, NOTIONALCURRENCY, CONTRACTDATE, EFFECTIVEDATE, MATURITYDATE, SETTLEMENTTYPE, CONTRACTSTATUS, MARKETVALUE, UNREALIZEDPNL, REALIZEDPNL, CONTRACTTERMS, REMARK, ORGID, CREATETIME, CREATEUSER, UPDATETIME, UPDATEUSER
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TBL_DERIVATIVES_CONTRACTS WHERE CONTRACTTYPE = #{contractType} AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY CREATETIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_DERIVATIVES_CONTRACTS WHERE UNDERLYINGTYPE = #{underlyingType} AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY CREATETIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_DERIVATIVES_CONTRACTS WHERE COUNTERPARTY = #{counterparty} AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY CREATETIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_DERIVATIVES_CONTRACTS WHERE CONTRACTSTATUS = #{contractStatus} AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY CREATETIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_DERIVATIVES_CONTRACTS WHERE CONTRACTSTATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY EFFECTIVEDATE DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_DERIVATIVES_CONTRACTS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND MATURITYDATE < CURRENT_DATE AND CONTRACTSTATUS NOT IN ('EXPIRED', 'SETTLED', 'CANCELLED') ORDER BY MATURITYDATE ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TBL_DERIVATIVES_CONTRACTS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId}
SELECT CONTRACTTYPE as contractType, COUNT(1) as count, SUM(NOTIONALAMOUNT) as totalNotional FROM TBL_DERIVATIVES_CONTRACTS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY CONTRACTTYPE ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT UNDERLYINGTYPE as underlyingType, COUNT(1) as count, SUM(NOTIONALAMOUNT) as totalNotional FROM TBL_DERIVATIVES_CONTRACTS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY UNDERLYINGTYPE ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT CONTRACTSTATUS as contractStatus, COUNT(1) as count, SUM(NOTIONALAMOUNT) as totalNotional FROM TBL_DERIVATIVES_CONTRACTS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY CONTRACTSTATUS ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT COUNTERPARTY as counterparty, COUNT(1) as count, SUM(NOTIONALAMOUNT) as totalNotional FROM TBL_DERIVATIVES_CONTRACTS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY COUNTERPARTY ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT NOTIONALCURRENCY as currency, SUM(NOTIONALAMOUNT) as totalNotional, COUNT(1) as count FROM TBL_DERIVATIVES_CONTRACTS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY NOTIONALCURRENCY ORDER BY totalNotional DESC

SELECT COUNTERPARTY as counterparty, COUNT(1) as contractCount, SUM(NOTIONALAMOUNT) as totalNotional, SUM(MARKETVALUE) as totalMarketValue, SUM(UNREALIZEDPNL) as totalUnrealizedPnL FROM TBL_DERIVATIVES_CONTRACTS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND CONTRACTSTATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY COUNTERPARTY ORDER BY totalNotional DESC

SELECT CONTRACTTYPE as productType, COUNT(1) as contractCount, SUM(NOTIONALAMOUNT) as totalNotional, SUM(MARKETVALUE) as totalMarketValue, SUM(UNREALIZEDPNL) as totalUnrealizedPnL FROM TBL_DERIVATIVES_CONTRACTS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND CONTRACTSTATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY CONTRACTTYPE ORDER BY totalNotional DESC

SELECT FROM TBL_DERIVATIVES_CONTRACTS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND ( (MATURITYDATE BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND CURRENT_DATE + 7 AND CONTRACTSTATUS = 'ACTIVE') OR (MATURITYDATE < CURRENT_DATE AND CONTRACTSTATUS NOT IN ('EXPIRED', 'SETTLED', 'CANCELLED')) OR (NOTIONALAMOUNT >= 100000000) ) ORDER BY MATURITYDATE ASC

SELECT COUNT(1) as totalContracts, COUNT(CASE WHEN CONTRACTSTATUS = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 END) as activeContracts, COUNT(CASE WHEN CONTRACTTYPE = 'FORWARD' THEN 1 END) as forwardContracts, COUNT(CASE WHEN CONTRACTTYPE = 'OPTION' THEN 1 END) as optionContracts, COUNT(CASE WHEN CONTRACTTYPE = 'SWAP' THEN 1 END) as swapContracts, SUM(NOTIONALAMOUNT) as totalNotional, SUM(MARKETVALUE) as totalMarketValue, SUM(UNREALIZEDPNL) as totalUnrealizedPnL, SUM(REALIZEDPNL) as totalRealizedPnL FROM TBL_DERIVATIVES_CONTRACTS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId}

SELECT CONCAT(#{contractType}, '-', #{orgId}, '-', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), '-', LPAD(COALESCE(MAX(SUBSTRING(CONTRACTNO, -4)), 0) + 1, 4, '0')) FROM TBL_DERIVATIVES_CONTRACTS WHERE CONTRACTNO LIKE CONCAT(#{contractType}, '-', #{orgId}, '-', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), '-%')

SELECT CHANGETYPE as changeType, OLDVALUE as oldValue, NEWVALUE as newValue, CHANGEUSER as changeUser, CHANGETIME as changeTime FROM TBL_DERIVATIVES_CONTRACT_LOG WHERE CONTRACTID = #{contractId} ORDER BY CHANGETIME DESC
